assessments.reasoning: The clause explicitly describes replacement and adjustments to the affected identifiers. The adjacent value rule applies to formals listed in the value part. The left-part restriction precludes treating every expression as admissible for a formal assigned in the procedure. The code-body clause marks a separate boundary.

limitations: Scope is the referenced report’s model of execution. The adjacent value-assignment rule and bodies expressed in non-ALGOL code have separate scopes. This establishes no compiler strategy.
